title: Consent-safe owned preference and snapshot paths
scope: Make owned preference changes necessary-only, and resolve consent before owned personalization/segment/reflex reads or manual segment assignment on both hosts; preserve consented behavior and headerless internal/analytics contracts.
non_goals: Partial W05/F05/F10/N06/N11/N12, customer first-party profiling and D10 consent only. No full W05/finding/gate/customer/release acceptance or changes to deterministic scorer, learning, external webhook/operator trust, headerless internal/live snapshot/identity paths or analytics historical self-access.

Preserve absent-state compatibility; recognized missing/malformed/error is not anonymous absence. Necessary refusal records remain bounded local containment, not D01/D03/D06 policy, retention or atomic copied-grant revocation approval. No native browser/UI reset/workerd/deployed/SLO claim.

No SDK/build/API-documentation/new suite/harness/infrastructure work. Existing boundary suite plus app noEmit/scoped diff only, expand solely for a concrete affected defect with lead approval. No stage/commit/push/deploy/cloud/credentials/customer-data/destructive/unrelated actions or subdelegation.

criteria.description: Owned personalization/segments/reflex reads resolve strict exact state and restrictive cookies before creation, seeding, qualification, FX/enhanced-variable evaluation, affinity/stage projection or profile-cookie generation. Either false returns existing safe empty personalization maps/segments, segments [], affinity:null/journeyStage:null and safe IDs/config/consent metadata; persist necessary refusal before success. Cold refused reads create no behavioral profile/pointer/visit state. Reuse resolved or newly created state where applicable, preserving consenting cold/returning behavior without a stale reread. Malformed/null/unknown/read/write/forward/wrong ownership/recognized-missing/expiry fail closed. Apply same owned consent gate to manual segment POST before profile/pointer/broadcast, both hosts deny refusal403. Headerless internal snapshot/identity and historical analytics remain unchanged.

Owned preference update uses strict one-read, preference-only persistence; preserve all existing behavioral data, counters/timestamps and user pointer. Merge false cookies for omitted switches; explicit current body boolean true remains deliberate enable. Cold anonymous refusal stores minimal necessary zero-counter instruction without pointer; cold all-consenting preference retains404, recognized-missing/errors deny. Response generates consent-only cookies directly, never personalization/profile mirrors; stable response shape with boolean cookiesUpdated and effective preferences. Necessary write failure is not acknowledged; recheck current target after awaits. Existing non-owned/internal preference behavior unchanged.

Only four production files plus existing realtime.sdkContract fixture. Group both-host populated/cold/refusal/cookie/error/re-enable cases; assert no seed/evaluate/egress/profile writes, exact preference-only mutation and no pointer/counter changes, positive actual qualification/decision and unchanged analytics/action/SDK behavior. Worker exact K1, app noEmit and scoped diff; independent exact K1 once and actual before/final source/full available proof/relevant local import graph/pins review. Preserve W05.07 acceptance historically and qualify changed shared-input proof before edits, without removing old fixes or whole-task reacceptance. No broad new suites or runtime/infra programme.
